submission.natural_language_explanation: Active (above 0.25 of max) on (1) every '\n' token that has another newline token among the previous 4 tokens (blank lines, short lines such as headings, 'A:', menu items; peak 0.5-0.9 of max), or that ends a line whose last token is '.', '?', ':', '{' or ').' (0.27-0.4), while a lone '\n' after a word, number, comma, quote or closing bracket stays inactive; and (2) in running prose, only on the word right after ' is', ' was', ' are', ' has', ' in', ' at' or sentence-initial 'In' when that word is a determiner, possessive or quantifier (the, a, an, my, her, this, one, what, all) or 'In addition/fact/order/terms' (0.26-0.44), plus, about 40% of the time, the curly apostrophe after a pronoun in contractions like 'I’m'. Every other prose token, including determiners after ' to', ' on', ' with', ' by', ' from', ' and', ' that', a comma or a noun, is predicted inactive; ' of the' and ' for the' are borderline (about 0.22-0.25, mostly inactive).
